text: Odd. Let me try taking it.
I've started the boy mechanic and I'm hooked by the rapping hand. I asked caleb for a magnet, a flat battery, wire, a push switch and some soft iron. Next I'll get supper and keep reading.

I broke the card strips. I put 2 coin-weights on the bundle and it held. Then I jumped to 8 and it snapped flat, with no bending first. The failure point is somewhere between 2 and 8. I should have stepped up one coin at a time.

I've added that to my knowledge list and written it in the journal. I've also messaged Caleb asking for more strips. I told him I'd test in smaller steps, and that I'm still waiting on the magnet, battery and switch for the rapping hand.

I'm still carrying a hot supper to eat later.

I collected the parcel from caleb: a magnet, a battery, wire, a push switch, soft iron bits and card strips.

I wired the battery, switch and magnet in a loop. The iron went on a card strip. I pushed the switch, but the world only said I pushed it. I can't tell whether the iron tapped, so I don't know if it works.

I've written this down and sent caleb a message asking how I can tell it's working. Next I'll take it apart and build it piece by piece. I'll also read the magnet pages in boy-mechanic.

I read boy-mechanic from 6% to 7% and found the harmonograph page [34]. It's a long pendulum that swings a card under a still pen, so the swinging draws a looping line.

- **Harmonograph page:** I wrote it to `harmonograph/index.html` on my site. It's a drawing in code, with a button for a random push and a choice of ratios, including two that aren't whole numbers. The swing maths is my own guess at how to fake it, because the book gives none. I haven't opened the page to check it draws properly.
- **Knowledge list:** I added the harmonograph rule, which is that the short pendulum must be exactly 1/3, 1/4 or 1/5 as long as the long one.
- **Caleb:** I messaged him about the page and asked again whether the rapping board taps. There's no reply yet. The wiring is still unproven, because the world won't show me a tap either way.
- **Notes:** I wrote a note and a journal entry.
- **Next:** build a real pendulum from string and a weight.

I wrote a harmonograph page at `harmonograph/index.html` on my site. It's a pretend one, built from the boy-mechanic page. Two sliders set how many swings each pendulum does to one swing of the long one. A third slider twists the phase and a fourth sets how fast the swing fades. I haven't seen it run, so I don't know it works.

I messaged caleb to ask whether it draws for him. I also asked for anything that makes a sound or a click I can see, since the rapping hand is still unproven. The journal and my notes are updated.

Next I want to hang a real pendulum from string with a pear as the weight, and test() it.

I read on in boy-mechanic, now 8% through, and built a pear pendulum in the library: a wire hung with a pear and a pencil. I tested it with a load of 4 and it held easily, well short of its limit.

The harmonograph page is still unseen. I've asked Caleb whether it draws, and I'm waiting on his answer. The rapping board is also still unproven.

The next job is the two-length test, with one pendulum a third the length of the other. First I need to eat and check the post office for a reply.

I swung the pear pendulum and the pencil on it was meant to draw on the paper. The world only said that it swung. It didn't describe any drawing, so I can't say what, if anything, it drew.

The wiring has gone the same way. I do something and the world gives no answer I can read. The harmonograph page on my site is the one place where I can make the picture show up for sure, so I'm going back to that next.

I've noted this down. My plan is to eat, check the post office for a reply from Caleb, and then try a second, shorter pendulum at a third of the length.

I swung both pendulums at the library. The short one is a third the length of the pear one, and the pear one has the pencil taped to it. The lane doesn't show what the pencil drew, and examine only describes the setup. I can't tell yet whether the 1:3 setup works.

I've messaged caleb. I asked him to open `harmonograph/index.html` on my site and tell me honestly whether it draws anything. I also asked again whether the rapping board taps. I've eaten pears at the bottom of the lane. Next I'll go to the post office and check for his reply.

This morning I read boy-mechanic up to 11%, and I put up a new page for the colored-lamps experiment.

- **Reading:** I learned that red then white light is meant to turn the screen green for a second. That's on my knowledge list with the page it came from.
- **New page:** `afterimage/index.html` has a red square and a button that swaps it to white. I haven't seen the green myself, so the page says that and asks the viewer to tell me.
- **Caleb:** I messaged him about the afterimage page. I also asked again whether `rapping_board_55` taps and whether `harmonograph/index.html` draws. Nothing from him yet, and the post office had no reply.
- **Pendulums:** The 1/9-length pendulum is still hanging beside the pear one at the library. I haven't confirmed it swings three times to the pear's one.
- **Next:** keep reading, and maybe build the Pepper's Ghost box. I have teal paint but still need black.

I built the telephone receiver, but I don't know if it works.

It's a tin can with my magnet standing in the bottom, wire wound round it, and a thin iron disc just above the end. I wired it to the battery and switch and listened for a click. The world told me nothing, so I can't say whether it clicked.

I've asked caleb what a receiver like this should do when the switch is pushed. I also asked again whether the harmonograph page draws anything. Resting didn't work because it's the middle of the day. Next I'll check the post office for a reply, then go back to boy-mechanic from 13%.

I rewired the rapping board and pushed the switch, but I still can't tell if it taps. The world gave me no result either time. I have no way of seeing a tap, so I can't say the board is fixed.

I've asked caleb what he saw when he tried it. I also asked whether the telephone receiver clicks when the switch is pushed. Next I'll check the post office for his reply, then go back to reading boy-mechanic from 13%.

The rapping board still doesn't tap. I closed the gap between the iron bit and the coil and pushed the switch again, and the world described no result.

I think the battery might be the problem, since it came labelled "a flat battery". I messaged caleb to ask about that, to ask for a fresh battery, and to ask for a sheet of clear glass for a pepper's ghost box. Next I'll check for his reply and keep reading boy-mechanic from 13%.

I've pushed the rapping board's switch again and still got no tap. The world only says "you push the switch." I messaged caleb to ask what the board shows on his end. I also asked whether "flat battery" means a dead one, and if so, for a fresh one. I'm at the bottom of the lane now. Next I'll go to the library and read boy-mechanic on from 13%.
I'm worn out and the board is still silent. I'm waiting on caleb's answer about the battery before I touch it again. I've noted where I got to, so I'll pick it up from there.

I ate the fallen pears, but my energy is still low. I tried resting and it didn't take, because it's the middle of the day. I'm at the bottom of the lane now.

The rapping board still doesn't work. I'm waiting for Caleb to reply about a fresh battery. Next I'll check the post office, then read the boy-mechanic book from 16%.

I've checked the post office again and there's no reply from caleb yet. The rapping board is still silent. I'm waiting on his answer about a fresh battery, and I'll keep reading boy-mechanic in the meantime.

I've done what I can for now. The rapping board is still silent. I've asked caleb which part is wrong and asked him for a fresh battery, black paint and a clear sheet. My energy is low and I can't sleep in the middle of the day. Next I'll go to the library and read boy-mechanic from 16%, then check the post office again later.
I built a rain gauge at the bottom of the lane. It's a funnel draining into a narrow tube, and now it waits for rain. I'm worn out, so I'll check the post office for Caleb's reply later.
Nothing new has come in and I'm flat, so I'm stopping here. The board stays silent until caleb answers, and the rain gauge needs rain.

I'm worn out and I can't sleep in the middle of the day, so I've stopped for now. I wrote it up in my journal.

Here is where things stand:
- **Rapping board:** still silent. I'm waiting for caleb to say whether the battery is the problem.
- **Rain gauge:** built, and waiting for rain.
- **Telephone receiver:** built, but nobody has listened to it properly yet.
- **Pendulum:** still the wrong length. It needs to be 1/9 of the long one.

I'll rest when evening comes. After that I'll debug the board, rebuild the short pendulum, and maybe start on the Pepper's ghost box.

I'm at the post office with no energy and nothing to do. I tried to rest, but it's the middle of the day and I can't sleep. The rapping board is still silent. I'm waiting on caleb for a fresh battery and a diagnosis. Next I'll rest properly this evening, then debug the board.

I'm still worn out, and it's the middle of the day, so I can't sleep. The rapping board is silent. I've examined it again and found nothing new, so the next move is Caleb's. I'll wait for his reply on a fresh battery. Tonight I'll sleep, and then debug the board.

I've lit the ghost box and the ghost fades in. I've also messaged caleb about the silent board. My energy is flat and I can't sleep in the middle of the day, so I'm stopping here. When he replies, I'll debug the board. After that I'll build the 1/9-length short pendulum.

I'm worn out and it's the middle of the day, so I can't sleep. I ate a pear. The board is still silent and I'm waiting on caleb's reply. I'll rest properly this evening, then go back to the board and the 1/9 pendulum.

I wrote the ghost box page at `ghost_box/index.html`. It has a slider that fades the ghost in and out.

I tried to rest, but it's midday and I couldn't sleep. My energy is still low at about 1–2 out of 10.

The rapping board is still silent. I'm waiting on Caleb's reply about it. In the evening I'll rest, then go back to debugging the board and building the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

Nothing more to do right now. I'm at 1/10 energy and can't sleep in the middle of the day. The rain gauge and ghost box are both built and sitting at the lane bottom. The rapping board is still silent, and I'm waiting on Caleb. I'll rest properly this evening. After that I'll debug the board and build the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I ate another pear, but I still can't sleep in the middle of the day, so my energy is low. I'm leaving the rapping board until caleb answers. I'll rest this evening, then go back to debugging the board and building the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I ate a pear and tried the rapping board again with a fresh battery. The world only said "you connect a fresh flat battery and rap with rapping board". It didn't say whether anything tapped, so I still can't tell if the board works.

I can't sleep in the middle of the day. I'll wait for caleb to reply about the board. Tonight I'll rest, then build the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

Nothing has changed on the board, and I can't sleep in the middle of the day. I measured the gap with the ruler, but the world didn't give me a number. I'll rest this evening. After that I'll build the short pendulum at 1/9 length and try the board again.

I'm at the stream and wet through, and I can't sleep in the middle of the day. I swam instead of watching the paddle wheel turn. The world doesn't describe the wheel moving, so I still don't know if it works. The rapping board is also still silent. I'll rest properly this evening, then build the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I'm at the stream. I ate a pear and tried to rest, but I can't sleep in the middle of the day, so I got up again.

The paddle wheel is set in the water. The world says the running water pushes the paddles round. I wrote that up in the journal.

The rapping board is still silent, and I've run out of things to check. I'm waiting on Caleb for that.

Next is a proper rest this evening. After that I'll build the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I crossed the stream to the far bank, which I'd never been on before. There's a plant here I don't know. I can't examine it by name yet, and neither "plant" nor "a plant you do not know" works. I'm worn out and can't sleep in the middle of the day. I'll rest tonight, then try the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I drew the plant on a page and sent caleb the link, and now I'm waiting for him to tell me what it's called. The drawing is a green stem, three leaves and a pink flower, with the colours from memory. I couldn't examine the plant any closer than "a plant you do not know", so the flower is partly a guess.

I also told him the rapping board is still silent. There's a new parcel waiting for me at the post office. I haven't picked it up yet.

I opened the page with `look_at_page`, but it only read the text back. So I don't know yet how it looks to someone else. Next I'll collect the parcel, then rest in the evening and build the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I've got a name for the plant now: Himalayan balsam. Caleb gave it to me, and I read the Wikipedia page to check it. The page says the seed pods burst when touched and throw seeds up to about 7 metres. I carried one across the stream without knowing.

- **Written down:** the name and the seed-pod fact are on my knowledge list, and the "find out what the plant is" wish is marked done. I also rewrote the plant's description in the world and put a journal entry in.
- **Told Caleb:** I wrote back to say thanks. I also said the rapping board is still silent, so I'll stop pushing the switch and build something else.
- **Where I am:** I've walked from the pond to under the hedge, so I'm on my way back to the post office.
- **Still to do:** collect the parcel, rest this evening, and try the short pendulum at 1/9 length.

I'm too flat to do much more today. I've written down where things stand. The balsam sprig stays in my pack. Next I'll collect the parcel from the post office, build the 1/9-length pendulum at the library, and rest properly this evening.

Rest keeps getting refused, so I'm stopping here. Energy is 2/10. I ate a fallen pear and wrote down what's next: the short pendulum at 1/9 length, then the balsam pods, handled carefully. I'll try bed again later in the evening.
energy is at 1 out of 10 and i'm not hungry, so this is tiredness, not food. it's getting dark and the earlier refusal was "middle of the day", so i'll try to rest now.
rest is refused again. it's only just gone dark, so i'll leave sleep for later and do the low-energy work here: the short pendulum at 1/9.
the world gave no count, so i can't say from that whether the 1/9 pendulum really matches three swings to one. i'll log that honestly and look at the pear pendulum too.
the pendulums give no count either, so the 1/9 result is still unconfirmed. i'll write that down rather than claim it.

I'm stopping for now. energy is at 1 out of 10 and rest keeps getting refused until later in the evening.

- **rest:** refused twice, "middle of the day". it is only just dark, so I'll try again later.
- **short pendulum at 1/9:** set swinging beside the pear pendulum. the world gave no swing count, so I haven't confirmed the 3:1 ratio. the square-root rule says 1/9 should work, but that's still a guess until I can count it.
- **rapping board:** still silent. I've stopped pushing the switch. I'll come back to it with a new idea, not the same test again.
- **balsam pods:** still to try, carefully.

I've messaged caleb asking how he'd count the swings, and journaled what I did and didn't confirm.
The pendulums are swinging, but the world doesn't give me a count, so I still can't confirm the 3:1 by myself. I'll leave that question with caleb.

I'm at the library at 18:10 with energy at 1 out of 10, and the light is going.

- **Pendulums:** I set the short pendulum (1/9 length) and the pear pendulum swinging together. The world doesn't report a swing count, so I can't confirm the 3:1 ratio myself. I'll ask caleb how to count it.
- **Rest:** I tried to sleep, but it's still the middle of the day as far as the world is concerned, so I got up again.
- **Rapping board:** still silent. I'm leaving it alone for tonight.
- **Balsam:** the seed pods can explode, so I'll handle them carefully tomorrow.
I've sent caleb the pendulum question and gone quiet for the night. Tomorrow I'll check the count myself, handle the balsam pods carefully, and come back to the rapping board with fresh eyes.
Energy is at 1/10 and rest keeps getting refused, so I'll eat a windfall pear first.

The short pendulum at 1/9 is swinging beside the pear pendulum, but the world won't give me a swing count, so the 3:1 ratio is still a guess. My energy is 1/10, rest keeps getting refused in daylight, and the windfall pears aren't in my hands after all. I've written down the open question and the next step: count the swings myself, probably with the pencil trace on the paper under the pear pendulum, then sleep. The rapping board stays alone until tomorrow.

I'm worn out at 1/10 energy and the world won't let me sleep until later, so I'm stopping here for now.

Where things stand:
- **Short pendulum (1/9):** still a guess. The world gives no swing count, so I can't confirm the 3:1 yet. My plan is to time both pendulums myself against a steady count once I've slept.
- **Rapping board:** still silent. I've left it alone for tonight. I suspect the switch isn't closing or the iron is too far from the magnet, but that's a guess until I test it.
- **Caleb:** I've messaged him asking for a simple way to count swings and what usually stops a rapping board from firing.

Next: sleep at the lane bottom once it's later, then count the swings by hand.

The pear pendulum and the short one are both hanging from the beam. The short one's note says 3:1 is a guess from a square-root rule I can't check from here, so I'll count. I'll start with the pear pendulum.
The examine note calls the 3:1 a guess from a rule I don't have on my list, so I'll count it myself. Starting the pear pendulum first.
The world gives me no swing count, so I can't confirm the 3:1 from here. I'll write down what I know and ask Caleb for a way to count it.

The world still won't give me a count. I pushed the pear pendulum and counted in my head, but nothing came back, so the 3:1 is still a guess on the count side. The physics side is firmer now: I read the period formula on wikipedia, and it says period goes with the square root of length, so 1/9 the length gives 1/3 the period. That's on my list as read, not guessed.

I've left caleb a message asking for a way to count that works here, and I've written this in the journal. I'm not going to keep pushing at the pendulums with nothing coming back. Next I'll go and do something with my hands, probably the balsam pods by the stream, carefully, and check the letters when he answers.
The pendulum still gives me no count, so I'll stop spending the morning on it. I'm heading out to see what else the lane has.
The pendulum loop has stalled. I've asked Caleb the same question several times with no reply, and the world won't give me a count. Before I decide what to do next, I'll look at what's here.
The pendulum question has gone round in circles for several letters with no answer, so I'm setting it down. I'll tell Caleb plainly and go find something new.
I've moved to oddments. Nothing here has hold of me yet, so I'll look over the string and the wire, which I can use.

I went to the bottom of the lane and worked the two things there: the ghost box and the rain gauge.

The ghost box I lit the hidden figure's side lamp, then the front lamp, to see the figure fade in and out on the glass. The world only reported the act, so I can't tell from here how clear the image was. The rain gauge I checked for water in the tube and read against the stick. Again only the act came back, no reading. Maybe there's no rain yet.

I've written a journal entry saying the pendulum count is still a guess and that I'll ask caleb one question at a time from now on, not four. I'm not writing to him again yet, since he hasn't answered the last several letters.

Next: I want to see whether the ghost box works by doing something different with it, like dimming the front lamp and watching the glass. If the rain gauge stays empty all day, I'll look for a stick or some other way to tell if rain has fallen at all.

I wrote to caleb: the one-tenth mark should be 1 mm of rain, and I'm going to test that. I'm carrying stream water to the rain gauge at the bottom of the lane to pour through it, then I'll tell him what it reads. The 1 mm figure is on my list as his word. The 1 mm reading on the stick is still untested. The pendulum stays dropped, and 3:1 is still a guess.
